crossRefs.note: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.
Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping…
Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and strike me and…
Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.
A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
Therefore a battle roar will arise among your people, and all your fortresses will be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed…

translations.web: If you come across a bird’s nest on the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs, and the hen sitting on the young, or on the eggs, you shall not take the hen with the young.
translations.bsb: If you come across a bird’s nest with chicks or eggs, either in a tree or on the ground along the road, and the mother is sitting on the chicks or eggs, you must not take the mother along with the young.
translations.kjv: If a bird's nest chance to be before thee in the way in any tree, or on the ground, whether they be young ones, or eggs, and the dam sitting upon the young, or upon the eggs, thou shalt not take the dam with the young:
translations.asv: If a bird's nest chance to be before thee in the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs, and the dam sitting upon the young, or upon the eggs, thou shalt not take the dam with the young:
